title: Spectral Components
approach: Root each colour at its 1-median (sum-of-distances, via rerooting); each added vertex then cuts the cost by the count of that colour below it, and those counts decrease downward, so a heap-driven greedy of size k_c is optimal. Sum of m_c = n forces per-colour work on the compressed auxiliary tree.

techniques.label: tree-centroid
techniques.why: the 1-median of a colour class is its weighted centroid

techniques.label: rerooting-dp
techniques.why: sum-of-distances for every root in one pass

techniques.label: heap
techniques.why: the greedy pops the largest remaining saving
